threads.title: [Bug] 升级至 0.2.1-rc.5 后，因第三方插件冲突导致启动崩溃 (1 required plugin did not activate)
threads.bodyText:
运行环境 (Environment)

OS: Windows 10 (10.0.19045.6466)
App Version: @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop 0.2.1-rc.5
Electron: 44.7.0
Node.js: 24.21.0
安装方式: 桌面端自动更新（从旧版本更新至此版本）

问题描述 (Description)
更新至最新版本 0.2.1-rc.5 后，应用无法启动，直接闪退并弹出 "The application could not start or stopped unexpectedly" 报错。
通过查看崩溃日志发现，启动时因第三方插件（疑似之前安装的 @linxin666/dsh-web-all 等）与核心服务版本不兼容，导致核心服务 sessionProjections 注册失败。这引发了连锁反应，导致必须的核心插件 agent-loop 无法激活，最终导致 33 个依赖该服务的插件集体挂起，应用启动彻底失败。
崩溃日志 (Crash Log)
DesktopHostFatalError: dsh: startup failed: 1 required plugin did not activate

Plugins waiting for services (33):
  Plugin                     Missing services
  agent-loop (required)      sessionProjections
  session-title              sessionProjections
  session-title-llm          sessionTitle
  ... (以下省略)
"完整崩溃日志见附件：crash-2026-10-31T15-44-26-802Z-host.log"

###复现步骤 (Steps to Reproduce)
在旧版本中安装过第三方插件（如 @linxin666/dsh-web-all、dsh-better-sidebar 等）。
通过桌面端更新机制，升级到 0.2.1-rc.5 版本。
重启应用，直接报错闪退。

###临时解决办法 (Workaround)
目前通过“清空环境”恢复了运行。具体操作为：
彻底关闭应用及后台残留进程。
进入 .dsh\profiles\desktop 目录，将 package.json 中的 dependencies 清空为 {}。
删除 node_modules 文件夹。
重新执行 pnpm install，仅安装官方基础包。
应用可以成功启动，但代价是之前安装的所有第三方插件都被清空。

建议与诉求 (Suggestion)
理解第三方插件可能存在不兼容的情况，但目前这种“一个插件出错导致整个应用无法启动且没有 GUI 修复入口”的体验非常影响用户。
希望能：
在启动前加入插件兼容性校验，或者提供类似“安全模式/恢复模式”的启动选项（绕过用户插件）。
对于非 core 插件的异常，希望能做到“优雅降级”（如日志中出现的 plugin degraded），而不是直接阻断整个宿主程序的启动。
在更新提示中增加对第三方插件兼容性的警告。

感谢团队的辛勤付出！

threads.title: @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client npm `latest` tag points at 0.0.1-rc.1, so an unpinned `dsh plugin add` is rejected as incompatible
threads.bodyText:
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client on dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 fails:
dsh: installation rejected: Plugin @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client@0.0.1-rc.1 is incompatible with dsh 0.2.1-rc.2: requirements {"@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm":"^0.0.1-rc.1","@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools":"^0.0.1-rc.1","@deepseek-ai/dsh-invariants":"^0.0.1-rc.1","@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess":"^0.0.1-rc.1"}. Running it may cause crashes or data loss. ...
dsh: nothing was installed.

Cause: the package's npm dist-tags are out of step with the rest of the scope, so an unpinned install resolves the first release candidate.
$ npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client dist-tags
{ latest: '0.0.1-rc.1', alpha: '0.2.1-alpha.5', next: '0.2.1-rc.3' }

$ npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh dist-tags
{ latest: '0.2.1-rc.2', alpha: '0.2.1-alpha.5', next: '0.2.1-rc.3' }

Workaround: pin the version.
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client@0.2.1-rc.2

That installs cleanly, mounts from cordis.patch.yml, spawns the server at boot and registers its tools. Verified with chrome-devtools-mcp@1.12.0 (35 tools registered as mcp__chrome__*) on arm64 Linux, node 22, pnpm 12.
Suggested fix: npm dist-tag add @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client@0.2.1-rc.2 latest.
Also, the install example in packages/mcp/mcp-client/README.md uses the bare package name, so it reproduces the failure for anyone who copies it until the tag is fixed. Happy to send a docs PR with a chrome-devtools-mcp example alongside the memory-server guide if that would be useful.

threads.title: Incompatibility of @xmanrui/dsh-im and @liustack/modlens with DSH 0.1.7-alpha.2
threads.bodyText:
Environment
• DSH version: 0.1.7-alpha.2 (profile ~/.dsh/profiles/web)
• pnpm: initially mixed v10.24.0 / v11.7.0, finally unified to v11.27.1
• OS: macOS (Apple Silicon)
Problem
After upgrading DSH to 0.1.7-alpha.2, two plugins fail to activate properly:

@xmanrui/dsh-im throws:

Error: cannot get property "webServer" without inject
at .../packages/client/connection/src/rpc-host.ts:192:19
The plugin fails to activate any channel.
2. @liustack/modlens throws:
[modlens] settings namespace skipped: TypeError: scope.settings.register is not a function
The settings namespace is skipped, so the plugin's settings UI is not registered.
Additional issue
While managing plugins, dsh plugin --profile web update failed with:
[ERR_PNPM_UNEXPECTED_STORE] Unexpected store location
because pnpm was switching between v10 and v11 stores. This was worked around by disabling manage-package-manager-versions and reinstalling the profile dependencies with pnpm 11.
What I tried
• Updated @liustack/modlens to the latest 3.26.3 – error persists.
• Downgraded DSH to 0.1.6-alpha.2 – the modlens error remains, so it is not version-specific.
• Reverted profile to 0.1.7-alpha.2.
• Removed both plugins – dsh web then starts cleanly.
Conclusion
Both plugins appear incompatible with DSH 0.1.7-alpha.2. The webServer without inject error suggests dsh-im does not declare the webServer dependency required by the new Cordis inject mechanism. The settings.register is not a function error suggests modlens still uses the old settings API that was replaced by the keyed slot system.
Workaround
Remove the incompatible plugins:
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web remove @xmanrui/dsh-im
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web remove @liustack/modlens
After removal, pnpm dsh web starts successfully at http://127.0.0.1:3080/.
Request
Please update these plugins to support DSH 0.1.7+, or document the required API changes for plugin authors.

threads.title: Upgrading DSH silently disables version-mismatched profile plugins; the reason lives only on stderr
threads.bodyText:
Mounting a profile plugin at a version older than the running build results in phase=no-fiber disabled=true with no visible reason. The only evidence is one stderr line at startup:
dsh: disabling profile plugin row ... incompatible with dsh ...

Desktop users never see stderr.
What it looked like here. After upgrading desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 → 0.2.1-rc.3, a @deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code 0.2.1-rc.2 row mounted in cordis.patch.yml stopped loading. Hooks stopped firing: a delete guard, a per-prompt routing note and a post-edit structure check all went quiet, with nothing in the UI. We noticed days later, by accident.
Why it was expensive to diagnose. di_loader_list reports phase=no-fiber disabled=true, which looks identical to a row disabled by config. Before reading stderr we tried three wrong explanations — absolute path instead of relative, moving the row to the end of the patch file, and removing the plugin's inject declaration. The third one broke the runtime (a service accessed without the declaration) and needed manual recovery.
Suggestion. Carry the reason into something queryable: a disabledReason field on the di_loader_list row would have ended this in one call, and the plugin inventory UI could render the same string.
Repro is mechanical: mount a plugin whose peer dependency version differs from the running build, restart, then read di_loader_list.

threads.title: [Bug] 社区插件带入的旧版 Web UI 组件抢先加载，导致 Desktop 图标按钮消失
threads.bodyText:
问题
社区插件间接带入的旧版官方 Web UI 组件，可能在 profile 根配置解析时抢先于应用自带的新版组件被选中，造成客户端组件混用版本。这里的“抢先加载”是依赖解析优先级问题，不涉及恶意插件。
实际表现是 Web 源码预览正常，而 Windows Desktop 打包客户端的侧栏折叠、搜索、视图选项、新会话等图标按钮不可见，输入框的加号、下拉箭头也消失。按钮元素可能仍在 DOM 中，但用户已经无法看见功能入口。重新安装客户端不能清理 profile 中残留的旧依赖，因此问题仍会出现。
环境与范围

Windows，本地构建版本 0.2.2-alpha.2，源码基于 9acf27f84a，包含本地修改。
安装过社区主题 @deepseek-ai/dsh-theme@1.0.7，其依赖带入 @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-theme@0.2.1-rc.3。
本地将 Desktop 复用 Web profile；这是自定义组合，尚未确认所有官方默认 profile 都会触发。
此报告针对共用的 Web UI 组件与 profile 解析；Desktop 是实际复现载体，不是 Windows 原生控件缺失。

复现条件

应用安装目录提供新版 @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-theme，以及引用 SVG symbol 的新版 UI primitives。
profile 的 node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-theme 中存在旧版 0.2.1-rc.3，来源可以是社区插件的间接依赖或旧安装布局残留；profile 本身没有将这个官方组件声明为直接覆盖依赖。
从该 profile 启动打包 Desktop，检查侧栏和输入框。

本地隔离复现中，保留这个旧版目录就能让整页图标表消失：



检查项
故障状态
本地修复后




svg[data-dsh-icon-sprite]
0
1


symbol 数量
0
194


侧栏折叠图标的 <use>.getBBox().width
0
13


鼠标点击折叠后再展开
功能入口不可见
两次点击均成功



旧版 ui-theme 不提供新版 primitives 所需的图标表。鲸鱼等直接绘制的 SVG 仍可显示，容易让人误判为部分按钮被条件渲染隐藏。
定位
packages/boot/app-boot/src/profile-resolution/resolver.ts 的 profile 查询会先选取本地物理包。对于根 Include，Loader 实际使用 profile 目录 URL 作为 baseUrl，因此只处理 cordis.yml 文件 URL 不够；客户端模块服务同样需要从正确的配置解析基址选中组件。
这里应区分两种意图：profile 显式声明的组件覆盖，与社区插件提升安装/遗留的间接依赖。后者不应无意替换应用配置中的官方组件。只保证 bundle 自身来自安装目录，仍不足以保证它配置的所有组件来自同一版本。
本地修复与验证
本地方案是在 profile 根目录 URL / 根 cordis.yml 发起配置插件解析时，优先使用运行时表中的 installation 包；profile 显式声明并安装的直接依赖继续允许覆盖，社区包内部的依赖查询保持原有规则。
新增回归用例覆盖目录 URL、配置文件 URL、显式覆盖和社区包内部导入。相关三份测试文件共 265 项通过；另 1 项既有文件符号链接测试因本机 Windows 创建权限限制未运行。重新构建的打包客户端在保留旧依赖的隔离 profile 上，图标表恢复为 194 个 symbol，并已用实际鼠标事件验证侧栏折叠和重新展开。
以上修复仅在本地验证，尚未提交上游 PR。
临时处理与建议
本次同时升级了主题到 1.0.11。不过，升级主题后，profile 锁文件仍一度复用旧 ui-theme，而且切换依赖布局后，原先根 node_modules 下的旧目录仍然存在。最终将有效依赖统一到 ui-theme@0.2.2-alpha.2，并在确认锁文件不再引用旧版后移出旧目录，才清理掉旧版加载入口。不要不检查引用关系就直接删除仍被使用的依赖。
建议配置插件与客户端资源采用一致的安装版本选择，并考虑对“实际选中的官方 UI 组件版本不同于运行时版本”给出可定位的诊断。Web/Desktop 共用 profile 或显示相同版本号，都不能代替检查实际加载的组件路径。

threads.title: 0.2.1-rc.2 upgrade broke a working install: hooks dist-tags, destructive rollback, duplicate package resolution
threads.bodyText:
Hi - this is a reproducible report from a single-user deployment of DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 on
Ubuntu 24.04. No client data is included.
We upgraded from 0.2.0-rc.2 on 18.10.2026. The upgrade took a working install down for
2.5 hours (267 restart cycles). Several separate problems compounded; each is
reproducible on its own. We recovered by pinning the hooks package to the exact runtime
version (0.2.1-rc.2), installing it globally and keeping only a symlink inside the profile.
Environment: dsh 0.2.1-rc.2, Ubuntu 24.04, Node v22.23.3, single-user deployment,
profile "web" with a hooks-claude-code row in cordis.patch.yml.


The hooks plugin is not bundled with 0.2.1. With a profile row referencing
@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code and the package absent, startup succeeds but logs
"hooks-claude-code: failed to import: Cannot find package". The plugin that protects
the attachment store therefore silently does not load.


The npm dist-tags are misleading, and this is what actually broke production.
npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code dist-tags returns:
latest: 0.0.1-rc.5, alpha: 0.2.1-alpha.5, next: 0.2.1-rc.2
The CLI itself has latest: 0.2.0-rc.2, next: 0.2.1-rc.2.
Installing "the obvious way" (npm install @deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code)
resolves latest = 0.0.1-rc.5, which requires ^0.0.1-rc.5 of dsh-llm, dsh-session,
dsh-agent, dsh-tools and others, and is incompatible with the 0.2.1 runtime by
construction. On the next start the runtime disables the row ("Plugin
@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm@0.0.1-rc.5 is incompatible with dsh 0.2.1-rc.2") and then fails:
"dsh: startup failed: 1 required plugin did not activate". The service enters a
restart loop. Note the asymmetry: when the package is missing the row is only a
warning; once an incompatible package is present it becomes fatal. The suggested
remedy in the message (dsh plugin allow-version) would run an incompatible legacy
plugin - which is the opposite of what a user should do.


Rolling back is destructive, and nothing warns about it. Sessions written by 0.2.1
cannot be opened by 0.2.0: "refusing to interpret the log - it was likely written by a
newer harness" (event job/registered). The service comes back, but the user loses
access to their own sessions. In our case this turned a 40-minute outage into several
hours.


Duplicate package resolution is reported without paths. After dependencies were
reinstalled inside the profile directory, the same plugins resolved from two
locations. The first symptom was "prompt section deployment:persona-prefix is already
registered", after which new sessions could not be created at all. The message does
not say which two paths conflict, which makes diagnosis slow.


Impact: 2.5 hours of downtime and 267 restart cycles on a single-user deployment.
What we would find helpful:

ship the hooks plugin with the runtime, or point its "latest" tag at a version
compatible with the current CLI line;
keep "plugin missing" non-fatal, as it already is when the package is absent;
state in the release notes that downgrading after sessions were written by the newer
version is not possible, and ideally provide a migration path;
include both resolution paths in the "already registered" conflict message.

We are happy to test a fix or share the journal excerpt (it is short and contains no
sensitive data).
Anton Grigoryants
ANO "Institute of Sociology and Artificial Intelligence Safety"
isai.su · cvo@isai.su

threads.title: # Plugin install can shadow runtime packages; boot failure then resets the profile config
threads.bodyText:
Repository: deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
Environment: Windows 10 Pro 22H2, DSH (Desktop) 0.2.1-rc.2, pnpm 11.28.5, profile with nodeLinker: hoisted
Summary
Installing a third-party plugin can make pnpm install a copy of @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools into the profile's node_modules. Because the profile uses a hoisted layout, that copy shadows the runtime-bundled version, the version guard disables the tools plugin row, and the host fails to boot. Worse, when boot fails, DSH resets the user's profile configuration (dsh.profile.bundles and cordis.patch.yml), which wipes the user's plugin setup as a side effect.
What happened

A third-party plugin (dsh-livedocs) declares @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools in dependencies (not peerDependencies).
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-livedocs runs pnpm, which resolves @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools@^0.2.0-rc.2 from the public npm registry → installs 0.2.0-rc.2 into profiles/desktop/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.
The runtime-bundled 0.2.1-rc.2 is not published to npm, so pnpm cannot resolve the correct version.
On restart, the version guard disables the tools row:

dsh: disabling profile plugin row "tools": Plugin @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools@0.2.0-rc.2
is incompatible with dsh 0.2.1-rc.2: requirements {"@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent":"0.2.0-rc.2", ...}


The host fails to boot (1 required plugin did not activate, agent-loop (required) → tools missing). On Windows the window flashes and exits.
DSH then resets the profile: dsh.profile.bundles is rewritten to ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app"] and cordis.patch.yml is replaced with the empty template [] (backups are created as cordis.patch.yml.bak-*). All third-party plugins disappear, and the user must recover them manually.

Issues this exposes

Runtime packages are not on npm. @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools@0.2.1-rc.2 only exists inside app.asar. Any plugin that declares it as a dependency forces pnpm to install an older npm version, which shadows the runtime one.
No install-time compatibility check for dependencies. The plugin installs "successfully"; the incompatibility only surfaces on the next boot, after the config has already been reset.
Boot failure resets user configuration. The automatic reset (bundles → 2, cordis.patch.yml → empty) turns a single bad plugin into a full plugin wipe. A user who does not have a manual backup loses their whole setup.

Suggested improvements

Publish the runtime package versions (at least @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools) to npm, or document a supported pnpm.overrides / link: pattern for third-party plugins that declare them.
Add a preflight check when installing a plugin: detect that a dependency would shadow a runtime package version and warn/refuse before writing node_modules.
On boot failure caused by an incompatible plugin row, disable only that row (and keep the rest of bundles / cordis.patch.yml), or at minimum restore from the automatic backup instead of leaving the empty template in place.

Workaround that worked

Remove profiles/desktop/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools (quarantine it).
Delete pnpm-lock.yaml so pnpm re-resolves without the pinned old copy.
Reinstall plugins with dsh plugin --profile desktop add <pkg> one at a time, checking node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools after each install.

threads.title: [Bug] Nested dsh-app-boot copy checks plugin compatibility against its own version, not the running launcher
[Bug] 会话目录残留一个明文世代文件 → workspaceController 不可用（工作区为空 / 卡在"正在加载工作区" / workspace/create service-unavailable）
threads.bodyText:
Summary
会话目录里多出一个明文的同版本日志（session.v4.jsonl，与正常的 session.v4.jsonl.zstd 内容一致）时，
DSH 在启动的会话枚举阶段直接抛错，导致 workspaceRegistry 初始化失败、workspaceController 不可用：

工作区列表为空 / 只剩一个；
「选择工作区」永远停在「正在加载工作区」；
添加工作区报 gateway/service-unavailable: typert gateway: workspace/create: active Service "workspaceController" is unavailable；
把 ~/.dsh/sessions 整体改名后重启 → 立刻恢复正常。

失败在进程内被永久缓存，必须完全重启才可能恢复。
Reproduction


在任意会话目录（后端为 zstd）里放入同版本的明文世代，内容合法即可：
~/.dsh/sessions/<project>/session-<id>/
    session.v4.jsonl.zstd   ← 正常
    session.v4.jsonl        ← 明文副本



完全退出 DSH 并重新启动。


观察：工作区列表为空；打开工作区选择器一直 loading；workspace/create 返回 service-unavailable。


对照：删掉 session.v4.jsonl 后重启 → 一切正常。


Current behavior
packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl 的 listArtifacts() 第一行就调用 ensureRootEncoding()，
而它在逐条容错（SessionPersistenceCorruptionError → 跳过）之前就抛出全局错误：
session artifact "...\\sessions\\<project>\\session-<id>\\session.v4.jsonl" uses .jsonl,
but this backend is configured for compression "zstd"; use a separate root or select
the matching compression mode

该异常冒泡到 packages/workspace/workspace 的 WorkspaceRegistry[Service.init]
（static inject = ['storageDomain', 'sessionPersistence']，初始化时 await this.listStoredHeaders()），
使 workspaceRegistry 不激活；workspaceController 注入它，于是整个工作区 API 消失。
两个放大因素：

ensureRootEncoding() 是 this.rootEncodingCheck ??= this.checkRootEncoding() —— rejected promise 被缓存，
删掉坏文件也不重试，只能重启；
UI 只能拿到网关层的 service-unavailable，上面那段带完整路径的原始错误没有任何渠道透出，
也没有用户可见的 host 日志目录（%APPDATA% / ~/.dsh 下都没有 logs/）。

Expected behavior
单个 artifact 的编码异常应当跳过并告警（与截断/损坏/未知版本日志的现有处理一致），
其余会话和工作区照常列出；该会话只在被显式打开时才报编码冲突。
Environment



项
值




DSH Desktop
0.2.1-rc.3


包
dsh / dsh-session-persistence-jsonl / dsh-workspace / dsh-api-workspace-controller 同为 0.2.1-rc.3


OS
Windows 11 25H2 (build 26200), x64


会话后端
默认 zstd


Profile
desktop（复现不需要任何第三方插件）



附：根因代码与建议修复
// packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl
ensureRootEncoding() {
    this.rootEncodingCheck ??= this.checkRootEncoding();   // 失败被永久缓存
    return this.rootEncodingCheck;
}
async checkRootEncoding() {
    await this.mapSessionDirectories(async (dir) => {
        const incompatible = await this.findOppositeGenerationInDirectory(dir);
        if (incompatible !== undefined) throw this.encodingMismatch(incompatible);   // 全局致命
    });
}

P0：checkRootEncoding() 改为「忽略 + logger.warn」，只在 requireStoredLog / rejectOppositeArtifact
这类显式打开路径上才报编码冲突；写路径保持严格。
P0：不要缓存 rejection（失败时清空 rootEncodingCheck，允许下次重试）。
P1：WorkspaceRegistry[Service.init] 对会话枚举失败做降级（记日志 + 空索引继续），不要连带整个工作区服务；
UI 在「正在加载工作区」处展示可展开的错误详情。
P1：把底层 message + 首个 cause 带到 service-unavailable 的 RPC 错误里，并提供用户可见的 host 日志。
P2：单 root 单编码 —— 检测到同一 root 已存在其它编码的世代时拒绝写入并明确提示。

回归测试：

会话目录同时放 session.v4.jsonl + session.v4.jsonl.zstd → sessionPersistence.list() 不抛错，仅告警；
在该条件下启动 host → workspace/list 正常、workspace/create 成功；
删掉多余文件后不重启，下一次 list() 能自愈。
